practical.text_zh: 免费开放花园。布伦黑白条纹柱阵(Les Deux Plateaux)在入口广场。开放时间约 8:00-22:30(随季节变动)。地铁 Palais Royal–Musée du Louvre(1/7号线)。
practical.text_en: Free public garden. Buren's black-and-white striped columns (Les Deux Plateaux) are on the entrance courtyard. Open roughly 8:00-22:30 (varies by season). Metro: Palais Royal–Musée du Louvre (L1/L7).
